title: The Invisible Payment
creator: Ihu / Princess Ada-ihuoma
summary: November 27, 2026: A sender locks a payment with an epoch deadline, secret hash and receiver key, with cancellation before the reveal epoch. The README changed during review: it now reports a November 27 Esmeralda deployment, although older unpublished-status sections remain. Current testnet explorer metadata identifies InvisiblePayment template 7cc97df35dd28e88dc3932e9fc0a2e49fd59b84d760defa1b4482b72a6e3746d and a committed claim transaction with a PaymentRevealed event for 1,000,000 micro-TARI. The event exposes its amount and receiver, so the creator’s blanket invisibility claim is not adopted. The public demo defaults to simulation; its wallet-connected behavior was not operated. MIT source and public creator evidence were reviewed. The genuine recording is a source/docs walkthrough with scripts and downloads disabled. No repository code, installed software, wallet or transaction was executed.
cardSummary: Explore payments unlocked by time, a secret and a recipient key, with a testnet contract and walletless simulation.
